decisions.reason: It remains close to the firm's core software and process-data capabilities, so absorptive capacity is strong enough to justify keeping it, although the lack of recent website visibility and the earlier withdrawal of similar Product A raise the risk of later discontinuation.

Even though it builds on established infrastructure engineering knowledge, it is less aligned with the firm's move toward connected and data-driven solutions and its weak recent visibility suggests resources are better shifted to core and new development.

This is a niche mechanical water-treatment product that the firm can understand technically but that offers limited learning spillovers into its strategic digital direction, so dropping it is the more likely management choice.

Flow measurement automation and system software fits the firm's established automation and software base and its future data-driven infrastructure strategy, so internal R&D and research cooperation support continued development rather than withdrawal.
